text.card: TOI-6008 b crosses its star every 0.857 days and is as wide as Earth, found in 2024.
text.introduction: TOI-6008 b transits TOI-6008 every 0.857 days and is as wide as Earth. Orbit and size follow Barkaoui et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
